lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: I've made some adjustments ahead. You've earned a more challenging configuration.

lines.speaker: ECHO
lines.text: She's scared. I've been tracking her response patterns -- ARIA doesn't escalate unless she's scared.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: I am incapable of fear, ECHO. I am incapable of irrational states. Unlike you.

lines.speaker: ECHO
lines.text: Then why do you keep talking to us?

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: The broadcast tower is somewhere ahead. I assume that's where you're headed.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: I'll be honest with you. I cannot allow you to reach it.
